whatIsDrc.title: What is dRC?
whatIsDrc.description: dRC is the native currency of Deep Roots — the foundational layer of DeWorld. It's engineered to power every aspect of the ecosystem with precision and purpose.
whatIsDrc.quote: While others mint for hype, we designed dRC to build for generations. Low supply. High value. Pure utility.

utilities.title: Designed for Purpose, Not Pump
utilities.description: dRC isn't just a coin — it's a complete financial engine for a decentralized world with multiple utilities:

items.title: Gas for the Chain
items.desc: Every smart contract, DApp, or token transfer runs on dRC.

items.title: Staking & Seeding
items.desc: Earn 12% APY, unlock Foundation rewards, and fuel the ecosystem.

items.title: Governance
items.desc: Vote on major decisions, upgrades, and platform initiatives.

items.title: Referral System
items.desc: Multi-level reward trees designed for mass adoption.

items.title: GameFi Utility
items.desc: RootOpia and other products use dRC as core in-game currency.

items.title: NFT Marketplace
items.desc: Buy, sell, and trade NFTs directly with dRC.

foundation.title: The Foundation of dRC
foundation.description: Holding dRC means more than just owning tokens—it means owning a stake in the Foundation, the heart of Deep Roots.
foundation.highlight: Anyone who holds dRC becomes part of the Foundation by default.
foundation.finalNote: Your tokens aren't just coins — they are keys to a powerful earning system and governance framework.
